comments.content: I don't understand what you mean but this should be generalized for other purposes outside of just error logs in the future.
Lets do the simple way then. Env var...or cant you just generate an "admin panel" in the bot private chat?

Yes there are logs but the public logs app isn't working so I would need to add you to the supabase project directly to view I believe. 
I do see the logs for it claiming to generate all of the permits, it just doesn't seem to actually post them. For example, I found the following three associated with this issue:
1. Generated permit2 url: https://pay.ubq.fi?&network=100
2. Generated permit2 url: https://pay.ubq.fi?&network=100
3. Generated permit2 url: https://pay.ubq.fi?&network=100

- We should have a webhook that we can post arbitrary messages to. 
- We must be able to configure where it dumps the arbitrary messages to (which group chat.)
- Requires some type of basic auth system, or else anybody can spam any group the bot is in. 
Inspiration: we rolled out a new update to UbiquiBot and there are errors with all the configs so its down on every repo basically. It would be ideal to receive push notifications that the bot failed to run so that everybody is alerted to fix the problem. Apparently its been about a full day for the team to diagnose (not great because it was me and I'm trying to not be on GitHub these days)
